text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 477 Church Street, Maitland Street flankage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 477 Church Street, with the following conditions: a. The patio shall only operate within the following hours Monday to Thursday – 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m., with the patio cleared of all patrons, tables and chairs by 11:30 p.m. Friday to Saturday and days before statutory holidays – 7:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. with the patio cleared of all patrons, tables and chairs by 12:30 a.m. Sunday - 8:00 a.m. to 10:59 p.m. with the patio cleared of all patrons, tables and chairs by 11:30 p.m. b.There shall be no amplified sound and/or music at any time on the patio. c. Doors must always remain closed when music is being played inside the establishment. d. The Licensee shall provide a telephone number for residents to register concerns or complaints.
